verdict.label: Full review
verdict.summary: Pick distribution first, because it's irreversible: custom distribution (one merchant or one Plus organization) works without App Store review; serving many merchants needs public distribution, a one-time App Store registration fee and Shopify's app review.
verdict.cost: Free for custom apps; one-time App Store registration fee for public apps

composioFit.summary: Shopify does not have a Composio-managed OAuth app, so you must bring your own OAuth app and configure custom auth in Composio.
whyOwnApp: Required to use your own client ID and client secret for Shopify OAuth

phases.name: Create App in Shopify Dashboard
steps: Go to the Shopify Developer Dashboard.
Create a new app and choose public distribution.
phases.handoff: Client ID and Client Secret generated

phases.name: Configure Redirect URIs and Scopes
steps: Copy the redirect URI from your Composio auth config.
Add the redirect URI to your app settings in the Dev Dashboard or shopify.app.toml.

phases.name: Test with Development Store
steps: Install the app on a development store.
Test the OAuth authorization code grant flow.

phases.name: Shopify App Review
steps: Submit the public app for Shopify App Store review.
Wait for the review team to approve the submission.

redirectRules.rule: Redirect URI must exactly match the URI configured in the Dev Dashboard or your app's configuration TOML file.

blockers.symptom: A second merchant can't install your app
blockers.cause: The app was created with custom distribution, which is limited to one store (or one Plus organization) and can't be switched.
blockers.fix: Create a new app with public distribution for multi-merchant use and go through App Store review.
blockers.fallback: Create one custom-distribution app per merchant for a pilot.

blockers.symptom: {"message":"Unacceptable Format","description":"We cannot handle the requested format."}
blockers.cause: Invalid client_id or incorrect authorization endpoint format during test probe.
blockers.fix: Ensure you use your correct client ID from the Shopify Dev Dashboard and target https://{shop}/admin/oauth/authorize.
blockers.fallback: Verify app credentials in the developer console.

blockers.cause: The merchant modified or denied requested access scopes during the authorization prompt.
blockers.fix: Check the granted scope response against your required scope list and re-prompt authorization if necessary.
blockers.fallback: Request scopes again via authorization URL.

blockers.cause: The shop domain parameter does not match the required myshopify.com pattern.
blockers.fix: Anchor shop parameter validation with regex ^[a-zA-Z0-9][a-zA-Z0-9\-]*\.myshopify\.com$.
blockers.fallback: Enforce strict string matching on shop domain.

checklist.text: Sign up for a Shopify Partner account.
Create a new public app in the Shopify Developer Dashboard.
Retrieve Client ID and Client Secret.
Obtain the callback URL from your Composio auth config.
Add the redirect URI to your app settings in the Dev Dashboard.
Configure access scopes in your app settings.
Input Client ID and Client Secret into your Composio auth config.
Install the app on a development store to test authentication.
Submit the app for Shopify App Store review.
